verdict.rationale: Attio documents kanban views for its data, a Deal object, and lists that model business processes, so a visual deal pipeline is a first-party capability. Its reporting also references stage conversion and stuck deals, which implies stages exist. However, the evidence never explicitly documents customizing pipeline stages or moving deals by drag-and-drop on the kanban. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of customizable deal stages, documented drag-and-drop stage updates on the kanban board, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates

citations.quote: From kanbans to tables, visualize your data the way that works for you.
